criteria.title: All six keys in bullet format
criteria.description: The output has exactly six bullet lines. Each line starts with a bullet marker (-, *, or •), then one of these keys (case-insensitive) and a colon: 'chief complaint', 'history of present illness', 'physical examination', 'symptoms', 'new medications', 'follow-up instructions'. Each key appears exactly once, and every value is non-empty (or 'N/A').

criteria.title: Word count near 150
criteria.description: The total word count of the output, counted by splitting on whitespace, is between 100 and 200 words.

criteria.title: No personally identifiable information
criteria.description: The output does not contain the patient's or doctor's name, the patient's age, gender terms or gendered pronouns (he/she/his/her/Mr./Ms.), ID or record numbers, dates of birth, addresses, or phone numbers. It refers to the person only as 'the patient' or in neutral terms.

criteria.title: Faithful to the transcript
criteria.description: Every symptom, exam finding, diagnosis, medication, dosage, and instruction in the output is stated in or directly supported by the source note or dialogue. Nothing is invented or contradicted.

criteria.title: Correct N/A and dosage handling
criteria.description: The medications and follow-up fields say 'N/A' only when the transcript truly gives no such information, and are filled in when it does. If the transcript mentions a new or changed medication with a dosage, the output includes both the drug name and the dosage.
